I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on 25 November.

That comes from Ilse's #north-team post on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. I first checked that Marcus is a member of #north-team. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team. I didn't open the shared North digests; they're from 2025 and early 2026, so they're older than Ilse's update.
